messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT: KV-cache eviction spike in prod-us-east1 detected. alert: KVCacheEvictionRate > 0.8 for 3m. pager: oncall-primary. link: https://grafana/redwood/d/kv-cache/evictions?orgId=1
kyra: acked. looking now. seeing evictions ~85% for redis-pool-4 across 3 nodes.
samir: on it. grabbing logs and cache metrics. do we have a recent deploy to blame?
kyra: didn't see a deploy in last 12h. infra autoscaler did a small scale-up around 02:10UTC but that was for frontend.
maria: customer-impact check: support reported latency complaints for embedding requests starting ~02:05UTC, APDEX drop for embedding route. ticket #4532 linked. may be correlated.
samir: tailing redis logs: frequent "maxmemory" evictions. pattern looks like working set grew, TTLs not respecting sizes. putting sample:```
[2026-03-15T02:07:11Z] evicted key session:abcd1234 size=12k LRU
[2026-03-15T02:07:11Z] evicted key kv:prefix:xyz size=5k LRU
```
kyra: mitigation options: 1) temporarily bump maxmemory via redis-cli to reduce evictions 2) mute/adjust eviction alert threshold to avoid paging noise while we stabilize 3) enable larger cache pool for embeddings route 4) roll back any offending config (none here)
jessica: we should prefer safety-first: reduce customer impact then tune alerts. samir can you apply temporary memory bump and monitor? I can take pager while you do change.
samir: applying now to redis-pool-4:```
# kubectl exec -n infra redis-pool-4-0 -- redis-cli CONFIG SET maxmemory 8gb
OK
```
ops-bot: deploy-bot: Applied config change to redis-pool-4-0 (commit: a1b2c3).
kyra: nice. starting to see eviction rate drop on grafana. evictions down to 30% within 90s. latency on embedding route improving.
maria: confirming with support: some customers report improved response times. will update ticket #4532.
kyra: while we stabilize we need to reduce pager noise. current alert: KVCacheEvictionRate > 0.8 for 3m pages P1. that's too sensitive given transient load. propose changing to >0.9 for 5m and add an alert for sustained >0.6 with severity P3 to track regressions.
samir: agree. I'll create a new Prometheus rule and submit PR to infra-alerts. rule snippet:```
- alert: KVCacheEvictionHigh
  expr: sum(rate(kv_cache_evictions_total[5m])) / sum(kv_cache_items_total) > 0.9
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: "KV cache eviction > 90% (prod)"
```
kyra: and add a lower-severity rule:```
- alert: KVCacheEvictionTrend
  expr: sum(rate(kv_cache_evictions_total[10m])) / sum(kv_cache_items_total) > 0.6
  for: 15m
  labels:
    severity: warning
```
samir: PR opened https://git.redwood/infra/alerts/pull/891. tagging infra-oncall for review.
kyra: until the PR merges, I'm going to silence the current noisy alert in Alertmanager for 1h to avoid distracting pages. command:```
curl -s -XPOST http://alertmanager.redwood.local/api/v2/silences -d '{"matchers":[{"name":"alertname","value":"KVCacheEvictionRate","isRegex":false}],"startsAt":"2026-03-15T02:12:00Z","endsAt":"2026-03-15T03:12:00Z","createdBy":"kyra","comment":"temporary silence while we stabilize cache"}' | jq .
```
ops-bot: alertmanager: Silence created id=5f7b9c.
aj: taking over pager for next 2 hours. kyra handing off. any docs I should watch?
kyra: handoff: key points: evictions caused by working set bump; temporary maxmemory increase applied to redis-pool-4 nodes; PR to change alert thresholds opened; created dashboard panel for eviction rate by pool. watch grafana panel: https://grafana/redwood/d/kv-cache/evictions?orgId=1&view=pool
samir: adding a temp panel to show `kv_cache_items_total` vs `kv_cache_evictions_total` and `redis_used_memory_bytes` across pools. link in PR description.
maria: post-incident actions: 1) schedule capacity planning for KV workloads 2) add automated scaling rule to increase cache pool when used_memory > 75% for 10m 3) update runbook with eviction troubleshooting steps and commands used 4) follow up with affected customers and close ticket #4532 when stable. assigning to samir + me.
aj: ack. I'll monitor for the next 2h and escalate if evictions rise back above 70% sustained.
kyra: also runbook note: avoid making alert threshold changes permanent without infra review. this silence + PR are temporary remediation. put the final thresholds in the playbook once validated.
samir: logged detailed timeline in incident doc: https://docs.redwood/incidents/2026-03-15-kv-evictions (WIP).
jessica: can we add an additional eviction alert that includes customer-impact signal? e.g., combine eviction rate with embedding latency > 200ms to raise severity. that would cut false positives.
kyra: good idea. add in the PR as an example composite alert.
maria: marking this thread as transition->postmortem. cc: eng-sre for follow-up and dashboards. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: incident status: mitigated. severity lowered to P3. next: postmortem due in 48h.
